'''Bo Marr''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[March 2001 Raleigh tournament]] on 3 March 2001 with [[Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can|Mind What You Have Learned]], according to Mike Merletto's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1829">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-04-raleigh-nc-3-3-01d1829/ raleigh-nc-3-3-01], DeckTech (Mike "OQrygg" Merletto, 4 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-04-raleigh-nc-3-3-01d1829/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
